description: List scores across all scenarios (bulk read of the same cached path) so catalog consumers (e.g. swarm-manager) can re-point from the legacy `scores --json` contract.

requirements.description: [DRAFT] A bulk list operation must read scores for all scenarios by iterating the same cached filesystem artifact path used by the single-scenario score read path. The output must be compatible with the legacy `scores --json` contract so that existing consumers such as swarm-manager can re-point to this implementation without breaking changes. Each entry in the bulk list must include at minimum: scenario identifier, composite score, maturity rung, and freshness summary. The bulk read must remain entirely filesystem-based with no network calls on the core path.
requirements.title: Fleet Bulk Score View Across All Scenarios from Cached Artifacts
